headline: Congress named a post office building in Greenland, New Hampshire after Chief Michael Maloney.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 609 Portsmouth Avenue in Greenland, New Hampshire, as the Chief Michael Maloney Post Office Building. It is a naming measure and does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 4, 2025.
